 I am a PhD student at the Data Lab for Social Good research group at Cardiff University. My research project, **“Reducing Health Screening Inequalities in Wales: AI-Driven Forecasting,”** focuses on developing data-driven methods to support fairer and more effective preventive health screening services in Wales.

My research combines AI, forecasting, fairness-aware ML, and simulation to identify inequalities in screening uptake and support better healthcare planning.
